closures_details.evidence: No buttons, zippers, snaps, or plackets visible on front, back, or sides within frame.

dominant_color.evidence: Uniform muted pinkish-beige tone across entire garment; no secondary colors or patterns altering base hue.

garment_class.evidence: Full-length silhouette with defined bodice and skirt; no visible waist seam or separate top/bottom structure.

likely_material.evidence: Openwork floral/geometric pattern consistent with lace construction; no sheen or drape suggesting knit or satin.

sleeve_cuff_neckline.evidence: Sleeves extend to mid-forearm with slight flare; neckline is high and rounded, exposing collarbone area.

surface_sheen.evidence: No specular highlights or light reflection; surface absorbs light uniformly.

texture_pattern.evidence: Repeating geometric and floral motifs formed by cutwork and raised threadwork across bodice and skirt.

weave_finish.evidence: Resolution insufficient to resolve individual warp/weft threads; pattern dominates visual texture.
